behaviour: A dark, salty, strong miso that is fermented a long time, often with more soybeans than grain. Its taste is deep and savoury, and it is stirred smooth into a little warm liquid at the end, because a hard boil dulls its scent. It holds up in hearty soups, stews and glazes.
